params.prompt: Keep this exact image unchanged except ADD exactly ONE face-up playing card lying flat on the felt at the central player position, below and forward of the gold curved line. The card is the white-faced QUEEN OF SPADES with crisp black corner Q and spade symbols and traditional queen face illustration. Its long axis runs towards the dealer with correct tabletop perspective, normal poker-card size. Astrid's hands remain EMPTY in their identical starting positions, left fingertips beside the shoe outlet, right hand resting near centre. Preserve exact face, gaze, body, framing, suit, table, lighting and shoe. No other cards or new objects. This is the final frame after she has dealt one card and returned her empty hands, not a new composition.

content.text: This tool provides an auto-updating generation widget for these jobs. Do not call job_display, show_generations, or show_generation_by_ids to display these jobs again, either before or after completion, unless the user explicitly requests a separate display. If you need to await completion, use jobs_wait with timeout_seconds <= 15. Use job_display only if the user explicitly requests a separate re-display of one specific job.

Note: adjustments applied — medias[0].role: "image" → "image_references" (GPT Image 2.5 backend expects schema-key media roles).
